title: Beetle God Ritual
description: A surreal black and white scene depicts a giant scarab beetle deity with multiple arms holding scales, a lantern, and a flaming chalice, positioned atop a dark mound. Hooded cultist figures in white and black robes surround the mound, performing a ritual with glowing rings and dripping purple and pink liquid, under a pentagram and lightning-filled sky.
